title: Closed-world ideal compiler cannot represent arithmetized recursive children
note: Challenges v2-all-root-composition in the ideal model. Production relations verify parent History proofs and wallet capsules by arithmetizing fixed Poseidon2b walks, so no plain-QROM ideal compiler can make those children represented, complete and uniform at the same time. The closed-world MissRep=false step fails, epsilon_ideal covers only natively verified roots, and Delta_P2b must carry recursive soundness. No forgery.
